scope.ray: match_type 1,2,3, paginated to last page; odds of every unique basketball entry
scope.pm: All 66 configured basketball series; event.closed=false; fully paginated keyset; individual market closed states retained

caveats: Ray/PM are separate HTTP snapshots, not atomic executable quotes. No bet precheck or orders were sent.
Shared line counts include locked/closed rows and prove structural overlap only. Only one of the three matched Ray NBA games had open selections in this snapshot.
PM volumes are cumulative venue-reported volume of all observed markets, including closed individual markets; not daily turnover, available depth, arbitrage count or profit.
Three matched games are insufficient to estimate long-term coverage, fill probability or profitability.
Full-game markets require confirmation of matching overtime and exceptional settlement rules. First-half moneyline PM tie resolves 50-50; corresponding Ray tie rule was not obtained.
Different lines cannot be treated as exact complements. Quarter/half/team identities must be preserved.

decision.interpretation: Corrected by user: at most seven specific market lines for hedging, not seven market types.
decision.selection: Enumerate event/period/market/line/team identities, identify complementary outcomes, and rank by net hedge return and executable size. Select up to seven; no fixed type quotas. See hedge-lines.json.
